name: U.S. federal data-at-risk monitors: ASA 'The Nation's Data at Risk' reports and monitoring; dataindex.us; Tracking Gov Info Project
provider: American Statistical Association (The Nation's Data at Risk; funders named: Alfred P. Sloan Foundation, Annie E. Casey Foundation, California Community Foundation); dataindex.us collaborative core team (incl. Denice Ross and Chris Dick; site footer shows the Federation of American Scientists); Tracking Gov Info Project (community project using University of Minnesota tools)
description: Three monitors of changes to U.S. federal statistics since 2024-25: the ASA assesses the health of the principal federal statistical agencies (programmes, products, budgets, staffing, leadership) in annual and midyear reports; dataindex.us tracks federal information-collection change requests, data health checks and terminations; Tracking Gov Info logs removed or altered federal documents, websites and programmes in a public spreadsheet. Use them to check whether a U.S. federal series in this catalog has been cut, delayed or altered.
institutional_access_note: All free on the web; no subscription.
found_via: Guide: Chapman University (https://libguides.chapman.edu/data_resources/archives); Guide: New York University (https://guides.nyu.edu/datasources/DataRescue)
unverified_notes: Opened 2026-11-11: ASA page https://www.amstat.org/the-nations-data-at-risk-year-two-ongoing-monitoring (monitors the 13 principal federal statistical agencies and other ICSP members; reports: 2024 Report; 'The Nation's Data at a Crossroads' July 2025; 2025 Report 10 Dec 2025; 2026 Midyear Update 28 Jul 2026; monthly 'Count on Stats' archive to October 2026); https://www.dataindex.us/ (sections: Take Action, Change Requests from OMB, Data Checkup, Terminations Tracker and newsletter; code GPL v3, content CC BY-SA 4.0) and https://www.dataindex.us/about-us (collaborative core team; no sponsoring organization named in text; start date not stated); Tracking Gov Info at https://z.umn.edu/trackgovinfosite, which redirects to https://sites.google.com/umn.edu/trackinggovinfo (community project, University of Minnesota Google Workspace tools, submission form plus public spreadsheet; no update date). Guides: ASA and dataindex.us are on the Chapman guide; Tracking Gov Info on Chapman and NYU. dataindex.us organizational sponsor (FAS) is inferred from a footer logo and one advisor's affiliation: UNVERIFIED. Borderline: monitoring and advocacy resources, not data sources.
